Wait, I could also cast Shoot the Sheriff to kill Ardyn! Then only the Spider-Man attacks, which I can block with Curiosity.

Let me sequence this:
1. First, cast Shoot the Sheriff targeting Ardyn
2. Then block Spider-Man with Enduring Curiosity

Or I could block Spider-Man with Curiosity and cast Sheriff on Ardyn. Same result.

Let me cast the removal first, then handleblocks.

annotations.description: Kimi25 Snark declined to cast Shoot the Sheriff on Oblivious Bookworm before combat. Oblivious Bookworm is a non-outlaw creature (Human Wizard), so it's a valid target. By not killing it, Kimi25 took 2 combat damage and the opponent will get card advantage from Bookworm's end step trigger. Shoot the Sheriff costs only 1B, which Kimi25 can pay with Watery Grave + Island or Fountainport. Removing Bookworm before it attacks and before it generates card advantage at end of turn is clearly the right play.

annotations.betterLine: Cast Shoot the Sheriff targeting Oblivious Bookworm before combat to prevent 2 damage and deny the opponent's end-step card draw trigger.

annotations.description: Casting Enduring Curiosity (which has Flash) during postcombat main phase taps out completely, losing the ability to hold up Shoot the Sheriff or Tishana's Tidebinder during the opponent's turn. Notably, Tishana's Tidebinder could counter Oblivious Bookworm's end step draw trigger.

annotations.description: Chose to copy Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man, but Wistfulness's ETB abilities require {G}{G} or {U}{U} to have been spent casting it. Since Superior Spider-Man costs {2}{U}{B}, neither condition is met, so the copy gains no relevant abilities beyond being a 4/4 body. Meanwhile, copying Oblivious Bookworm would have granted a repeatable end-step card draw ability, which is significant ongoing value when the player only has 2 cards in hand and is facing two Enduring Curiosities.

annotations.betterLine: Choose Oblivious Bookworm to gain the repeatable end-step draw ability on a 4/4 body, providing much-needed card advantage.

annotations.description: At 2 life facing an opponent at 16 with Enduring Curiosity on board, copying Oblivious Bookworm gives a vanilla 4/4 ground creature with minor card draw upside. Deep-Cavern Bat would give a 4/4 with flying and lifelink (critical at 2 life for survival and racing) plus hand disruption on ETB to potentially exile a key spell like Shoot the Sheriff or Bitter Triumph.

annotations.betterLine: Copy Deep-Cavern Bat to get a 4/4 flying lifelinker that can stabilize life total and disrupt opponent's hand, which is far more impactful at 2 life
